title: Reconcile AS2 systemPrompt guidance now that 1314 makes field initializers work
description: Task 1314 (commit 65effa8) fixed the AS2 compiler so instance field initializers (var x:Number = 0) ARE hoisted into the constructor and now run for className-linked placed symbols. The guidance added in task 1313 to packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/systemPrompt.ts (the '# AS2 scripting' section) still says field initializers 'may not run for className-linked placed symbols' — now FALSE/misleading. UPDATE that section to be accurate + concise: field initializers ARE supported (compiled into the constructor and run per-instance); initializing in an explicit constructor is also fine/equivalent. Drop the 'may not run / undefined / NaN' warning. Keep it short. VERIFY: build green; authoring-ui tests green incl systemPrompt.test.ts (update matchers if they assert the old wording). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: systemPrompt.ts (+ its test if needed).
